scope: Cloud Chromium, actual IndexedDB and two tabs. No physical-device or human evidence.
method: Save a conflict copy in the second tab, resize the unchanged original tab by one CSS pixel, wait for layout frames and settled save status, then compare the last-entry key/revision before reloading.
change: ResizeObserver uses fit(false); explicit Fit and authored edits still persist.
separateTimingFailures: Initial Fit/New click timeouts were observed separately. This regression proves the recovery race; it does not establish the root cause of every automation timeout.
